details: Importing ig_gox runs ig_gox/__init__.py, which decodes a blob (base64, XOR, zlib) after a few anti-debugging checks and execs it as __main__. The decoded loader only goes on if it looks like a physical Android device running Termux (it turns away x86, emulators and VMs), installs requests and cryptography if they are missing, downloads encrypted code from https://goxtools.shop/api/admin/storage.php, decrypts it with AES-256-CBC and runs it in memory. The README only calls it a runtime engine for Termux. I decoded the loader statically and did not see what the downloaded code does. I read 1.0.0 and did not run it.
